pools.name: Balboa Pool
notes: Indoor, 6 lanes. $8 adults.
Wednesday afternoon and Saturday morning lap swim in the main pool only; the small pool is open for shallow-water laps during lap swim.
Lap swim is closed every 4th Thursday of the month, 11:30am–2pm.

pools.name: North Beach Pool
notes: Times are for the cool lap pool (76 °F). The warm pool (86 °F) has its own lap/therapy sessions; see the schedule. $8 adults.
Closed 13–31 October for annual maintenance.

pools.name: Hamilton Pool
notes: 4 to 6 lap lanes depending on the session; Saturday 9am 5 lanes. Entrance on Post Street. $8 adults.
Closed 23–29 November for maintenance.

pools.name: Rossi Pool
notes: Pool length 33⅓ yards. Evening sessions on Tuesday and Thursday and Wednesday afternoon have 3 lanes. $8 adults.
Closed 2–21 November for annual maintenance.

pools.name: Lions Pool
notes: 5 lanes, warm water (81–83 °F). $7 per visit, 10 swims $61.
Closes at 2:30pm on 24 and 31 December.

pools.name: deFremery Pool
